BREWING.GUIDE

Coffee brewing tools and references.

A ratio calculator, a stage timer, a flavor compass, plus reference pages for methods, tasting terms, and per-bag brew tracking.

TOOLS
3 ITEMS
Brew Calculator

Dose, ratio, water, grind, temperature, and time for every brew method.

OPEN →
Brew Timer

Stage-by-stage timer for pour over, French press, AeroPress, and espresso.

OPEN →
Brew Compass

Pick the flavors in your cup and get a specific adjustment for the next brew.

OPEN →
GUIDES
3 ITEMS
Troubleshooter

Common coffee problems and the fix that usually works.

OPEN →
Brewing Methods

Reference page for every brew method with a grind size chart.

OPEN →
Tasting Glossary

Plain-language definitions of 52 coffee tasting terms.

OPEN →
Desktop

Each tool works on its own. Open the calculator, timer, or compass directly from the nav and use it independently. Settings don't carry between them.

Mobile

The tools are connected. The calculator feeds the timer, the timer hands off to the compass, and the compass loops back to the calculator with adjustments. Each session logs to the Bag Log so you can track how a coffee dials in over time.

OPEN ON YOUR PHONE
Scan to open the dial-in flow on mobile.

About the Brew Compass

The Brew Compass is a flavor-to-fix tool. Pick the flavors you taste in your cup and the problems you want to solve, and the compass returns a specific brewing adjustment to make on your next brew: grind finer or coarser, raise or lower water temperature, dose more or less coffee, or change the ratio.

HOW TO USE IT
Pick the method you just brewed.
Tap the flavors and tasting notes that describe your cup (sour, bitter, thin, heavy, grassy, fruity, sweet, balanced).
Read the adjustment the compass returns, with a brief note on why.
Apply the adjustment on your next brew. Repeat to dial in.

Prefer a text-based version? The Troubleshooter covers the same common problems (sour, bitter, thin, heavy, grassy, channeling) with plain-language fixes. The Tasting Glossary defines every flavor term in plain language. When you're ready to brew again, head back to the Brew Calculator.

About the Brew Timer

Stage-by-stage brew timer with audio and haptic cues. Each method has its own staged flow (bloom, pours, drawdown for pour over; pour, steep, press for AeroPress; etc.) and the timer counts down each stage with cues at the transitions so you can keep hands on the kettle.

SUPPORTED METHODS
Pour Over — bloom, two main pours, final pour, drawdown.
French Press — pour, steep, press, decant.
AeroPress — pour, steep, press.
Espresso — pre-infuse, extract, stop.
Cold Brew — read-only step list (long passive steep, no countdown).
Moka Pot — read-only step list (continuous heat, no countdown).

Need a dose, ratio, or grind reference first? The Brew Calculator handles the numbers. The Brewing Methods page covers each method in detail with full step-by-step process notes. If your brew tastes off, head to the Brew Compass for a flavor-to-fix adjustment.

About the Brew Compass

The Brew Compass is a flavor-to-fix tool. Pick the flavors you taste in your cup and the problems you want to solve, and the compass returns a specific brewing adjustment to make on your next brew: grind finer or coarser, raise or lower water temperature, dose more or less coffee, or change the ratio.

HOW TO USE IT
Pick the method you just brewed.
Tap the flavors and tasting notes that describe your cup (sour, bitter, thin, heavy, grassy, fruity, sweet, balanced).
Read the adjustment the compass returns, with a brief note on why.
Apply the adjustment on your next brew. Repeat to dial in.

Prefer a text-based version? The Troubleshooter covers the same common problems (sour, bitter, thin, heavy, grassy, channeling) with plain-language fixes. The Tasting Glossary defines every flavor term in plain language. When you're ready to brew again, head back to the Brew Calculator.
